Nathaniel Hawthorne, The Blithedale Romance.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/nathaniel-hawthorne/the-blithedale-romance

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Nathaniel Hawthorne, the author and writer of the preface, died 1864.

First publication of the text used: 1852 (SE colophon: 'The Blithedale Romance was published in 1852 by Nathaniel Hawthorne.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1852, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement below says it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person whose words are in the text died by 1925 (last death: 1864), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
